**HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.1 is the release candidate:** what 1.1.0 will be unless a blocker turns up. If you'd rather wait, stay on [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2): it's still the current release. The final 1.1.0 follows after a few days of testing ([#135](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/135)).

It comes with **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto [2.2.0-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.1)** and **ADB [1.0.1-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-adb/releases/tag/v1.0.1-rc.1)**. NEMESIS in the app menu is the same as in 1.0.2.

## What's new since 1.1.0-beta.1

- **After a firmware update, HMG-API installs and uninstalls cleanly** (#166). An update removes HMG-API's system files but keeps its data, and uninstalling then failed ("Operation failed" in NEMESIS). Now installing HMG-API again starts from the new firmware's files, and uninstalling works too. The app says what happened instead of "Can't reach hmgapid". If your unit is stuck like that on 1.0.2 or the beta, install this release over it.
- **Hook maps for five more US cars**, from their owners' Car Reports: Kia Sportage, Telluride, Niro EV and Carnival (260507), and Hyundai Palisade (260903). Thanks to AwsomeFox and the owners who sent reports.
- **Vehicle readings answer at once** (#145): each reading took 3 seconds before.
- **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.0-rc.1:**
  - Android Auto roundabouts go the right way round (US roundabouts were drawn clockwise) with "Android Auto turns in the car's own format" on. Thanks to AwsomeFox (wireless #19).
  - "Recalculating…" on the cluster during a reroute, with that setting on.
  - Wireless CarPlay no longer stops for good after a short Wi-Fi stall.
- **ADB 1.0.1-rc.1:** adb over the hotspot works on cars whose stock firewall blocked it. Thanks to crashahotrod.
- The full list is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0-rc.1/CHANGELOG.md), including what came in 1.1.0-beta.1 ([its notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-beta.1)).

## Installing

- **From 1.0.x or the beta:** put `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.1-update.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick, then HMG-API app → **Check USB updates**. Then restart the head unit once. Your mods and settings stay. To update the wireless and ADB mods too, also put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-rc.1.zip` and `adb-1.0.1-rc.1.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/`, pick them in Check USB updates, and **Apply changes**.
- **With NEMESIS:** unzip `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.1-nemesis.zip` onto a stick and update from NEMESIS Manager's Package Store.
- **New install, or after a firmware update:** as in [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API), with `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.1-usb.zip`.

## What to test

- The app shows **1.1.0-rc.1** and "Hooks on". Your mods still run after the update and a restart.
- **Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto on a drive:** connecting, audio, calls, and turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD. With Android Auto and "turns in the car's own format" on: a roundabout (counterclockwise, exit on the right side) and a missed turn.
- **Sportage, Telluride, Niro EV, Carnival or Palisade:** HMG-API app → Settings → **Check the map on this car**, restart, then a [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report). Reports from a car or two let us mark the map as checked for everyone.
- **Ioniq 5 on 260903:** the same check and a Car Report, if you haven't sent one.
- **If you update the head unit's firmware:** install HMG-API again afterwards and tell us how it went.

## Known issues

- **Ioniq 5 on 260903:** the wireless mod doesn't list this software yet, so it says "isn't for this head unit". Install anyway works, at your own risk.
- With Android Auto's turns in the car's own format, on-ramps still show the projection icon, so the AR HUD doesn't animate there (wireless #30).
- The rest are the same as in [1.0.0](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.0). For example, a USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting. Take the stick out after installing.

## Going back to 1.0.2

The app won't install an older HMG-API over a newer one, so either:
- **With adb:** `adb push hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip /data/local/tmp/`, then `adb shell hmgapid engine update-hmgapi /data/local/tmp/hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip --force`. Restart the head unit.
- **Without adb:** uninstall HMG-API ([Uninstalling](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Uninstalling), without `PURGE`, so your mods and settings stay), restart, then install [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2) as new.

For wireless 2.1.0: remove the mod in the app and apply, then install `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip` from 1.0.2's release with Check USB updates.

## Reporting

A [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report), or [open an issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with:
- your car;
- the head unit software (e.g. 260507 or 260903);
- the HMG-API version (1.1.0-rc.1) and the wireless mod's version;
- what you did and what happened.

Problems with wireless CarPlay or Android Auto go [in the mod's repo](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/issues/new/choose). Please don't post your VIN, serial numbers or phone numbers; nothing needs them.
